description: Triage of a GitHub or agent notification before the orchestrating session spends reasoning on it. State: { event: <kind>, data: <the event's JSON payload> }, never the harness's injected instructions. The session reads the PR or thinks only when kind is ci_failed, conflict or review_comment, needs_action is yes, or anything escalates (thresholds 0.5: the small model's probabilities are compressed, see docs/DECIDE.md); ci_passed and merged are handled by their scripted next step (merge when approved; report).

questions.instructions: What happened to the pull request in this event?

options.ci_passed: check_suite.completed: CI finished and no check suite is running or failed
options.ci_failed: check_run.completed with conclusion failure: a CI check failed
options.merged: pull_request.closed with outcome merged: the pull request was merged
options.conflict: the pull request cannot merge: mergeable false, merge conflict, dirty
options.review_comment: a person wrote a review or a comment on the pull request
options.subscription_noise: bookkeeping only: subscription created, ready for review, draft state; nothing happened to code or CI

questions.instructions: Must the agent do work on the pull request now?

options.yes: a check failed, there is a merge conflict, or a person wrote a review comment
options.no: CI passed, the pull request was merged, or the event is bookkeeping

questions.instructions: Should the owner hear about this event?

options.yes: the pull request was merged, or a person wrote a review comment
options.no: CI result, merge conflict or bookkeeping that the agent handles alone
